text.opengl: Create the depth cube map – six 1024 × 1024 `GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT` faces attached as a whole (layered) to a framebuffer without colour – and fill all six faces in one pass from the light: the geometry shader sends every triangle to each face (`gl_Layer`), the fragment shader writes the distance to the light / `far_plane` as the depth. Then show the cube map as grey in the scene's fragment shader.
text.vulkan: Create the depth cube map – one depth image with six layers that can be viewed as a cube, a framebuffer with six layers, a sampler and a depth pipeline with a geometry shader that sends every triangle to each face (`gl_Layer`) and writes the distance to the light / `far_plane` as the depth – record that pass before the window's, and show the cube map as grey in the scene's fragment shader.
text.d3d12: Create the depth cube map – a 1024 × 1024 `R32_TYPELESS` resource with six slices, a `TEXTURE2DARRAY` depth stencil view over all six and a `TEXTURECUBE` shader resource view – and a depth pipeline state whose geometry shader sends every triangle to each face (`SV_RenderTargetArrayIndex`) and whose pixel shader writes the distance to the light / `far_plane` (`SV_Depth`); draw that pass every frame and show the cube map as grey in `PSMain`.

hint.opengl: `glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP, depthCubemap)`, six `glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_POSITIVE_X + i, 0, GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT, …)`, `glFramebufferTexture(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT, depthCubemap, 0)` (no `2D`). `shadowProj = glm::perspective(glm::radians(90.0f), …, near_plane, far_plane)` times six `glm::lookAt(lightPos, lightPos + dir, up)`. GS: `gl_Layer = face;`, `gl_Position = shadowMatrices[face] * FragPos;`. FS: `gl_FragDepth = length(FragPos.xyz - lightPos) / far_plane;`. Debug: `texture(depthMap, fs_in.FragPos - lightPos).r` on a `samplerCube` (unit 1).
hint.vulkan: `flags = VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT`, `arrayLayers = 6`, a `VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE` view with `layerCount = 6`, `framebufferInfo.layers = 6`. Uniform buffer: `float far_plane;` in place of `pad2`, then `glm::mat4 shadowMatrices[6];` – no y flip in `shadowProj`. `deviceFeatures.geometryShader = VK_TRUE`, `VK_SHADER_STAGE_GEOMETRY_BIT` for the UBO. GS: `gl_Layer = face;`; FS: `gl_FragDepth = length(fragPos.xyz - ubo.lightPos) / ubo.far_plane;`. Debug: `texture(depthMap, fs_in.fragPos - ubo.lightPos).r` (binding 2).
hint.d3d12: `Tex2D(DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS, SHADOW_WIDTH, SHADOW_HEIGHT, 6, 1, 1, 0, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_DEPTH_STENCIL)`; DSV `D3D12_DSV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DARRAY` with `ArraySize = 6`, SRV `D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURECUBE`. `shadowProj = XMMatrixPerspectiveFovRH(…) * XMMatrixScaling(1.0f, -1.0f, 1.0f)`, `XMMatrixLookAtRH(…) * shadowProj`. GS: `output.layer = face;` (`SV_RenderTargetArrayIndex`); PS: `float PSMain(PSInput input) : SV_Depth`. Debug: `depthMap.Sample(shadowSampler, input.fragPos - lightPos).r`.

text.opengl: Draw the lit scene with shadows again: `ShadowCalculation(fragPos)` reads the closest depth in the direction from the light to the fragment, turns it back into a distance (`* far_plane`) and compares it with the fragment's own distance to the light, with a bias of 0.05.
text.vulkan: Draw the lit scene with shadows again: `ShadowCalculation(fragPos)` reads the closest depth in the direction from the light to the fragment, turns it back into a distance (`* ubo.far_plane`) and compares it with the fragment's own distance to the light, with a bias of 0.05.
text.d3d12: Draw the lit scene with shadows again: `ShadowCalculation(fragPos)` reads the closest depth in the direction from the light to the fragment, turns it back into a distance (`* far_plane`) and compares it with the fragment's own distance to the light, with a bias of 0.05.

hint.opengl: `vec3 fragToLight = fragPos - lightPos; float closestDepth = texture(depthMap, fragToLight).r * far_plane; float currentDepth = length(fragToLight);` then `currentDepth - bias > closestDepth ? 1.0 : 0.0`. In `main`: `float shadow = ShadowCalculation(fs_in.FragPos);` and `FragColor = vec4(lighting, 1.0);` again.
hint.vulkan: `vec3 fragToLight = fragPos - ubo.lightPos; float closestDepth = texture(depthMap, fragToLight).r * ubo.far_plane; float currentDepth = length(fragToLight);` then `currentDepth - bias > closestDepth ? 1.0 : 0.0`. In `main()`: `float shadow = ShadowCalculation(fs_in.fragPos);` and `outColor = vec4(lighting, 1.0);` again.
hint.d3d12: `float3 fragToLight = fragPos - lightPos; float closestDepth = depthMap.Sample(shadowSampler, fragToLight).r * far_plane; float currentDepth = length(fragToLight);` then `currentDepth - bias > closestDepth ? 1.0f : 0.0f`. In `PSMain`: `float shadow = ShadowCalculation(input.fragPos);` and `return float4(lighting, 1.0f);` again.

text.opengl: Soften the shadow's edges with learnopengl's PCF for cube maps: average 20 comparisons in the `gridSamplingDisk` offset directions around `fragToLight`, scaled by a disk radius that grows with the distance to the viewer; bias 0.15.
text.vulkan: Soften the shadow's edges with learnopengl's PCF for cube maps: average 20 comparisons in the `gridSamplingDisk` offset directions around `fragToLight`, scaled by a disk radius that grows with the distance to the viewer; bias 0.15.
text.d3d12: Soften the shadow's edges with learnopengl's PCF for cube maps: average 20 comparisons in the `gridSamplingDisk` offset directions around `fragToLight`, scaled by a disk radius that grows with the distance to the viewer; bias 0.15.

hint.opengl: Global `vec3 gridSamplingDisk[20] = vec3[](…)` (a cube's 8 corners and 12 edge middles). `float diskRadius = (1.0 + (viewDistance / far_plane)) / 25.0;`, loop `i < samples` (20): `texture(depthMap, fragToLight + gridSamplingDisk[i] * diskRadius).r * far_plane`, `if(currentDepth - bias > closestDepth) shadow += 1.0;`, then `shadow /= float(samples);`.
hint.vulkan: Global `vec3 gridSamplingDisk[20] = vec3[](…)` (a cube's 8 corners and 12 edge middles). `float diskRadius = (1.0 + (viewDistance / ubo.far_plane)) / 25.0;`, loop `i < samples` (20): `texture(depthMap, fragToLight + gridSamplingDisk[i] * diskRadius).r * ubo.far_plane`, `if (currentDepth - bias > closestDepth) shadow += 1.0;`, then `shadow /= float(samples);`.
hint.d3d12: `static const float3 gridSamplingDisk[20] = { … };` (a cube's 8 corners and 12 edge middles). `float diskRadius = (1.0f + (viewDistance / far_plane)) / 25.0f;`, loop `i < samples` (20): `depthMap.Sample(shadowSampler, fragToLight + gridSamplingDisk[i] * diskRadius).r * far_plane`, `if (currentDepth - bias > closestDepth) shadow += 1.0f;`, then `shadow /= float(samples);`.

ex-animate-light.text: Let the light move back and forth through the room: its z goes as sin(time × 0.5) × 3. Watch the cube's shadow slide over the wall.

hint.opengl: learnopengl's line is already in the render loop, commented out – before the cube map's matrices are made, so the depth pass and the lighting see the same position.
hint.vulkan: Set `lightPos.z` at the top of `updateUniformBuffer()`, from `glfwGetTime()`, before the six shadow matrices are made – so the depth pass and the lighting see the same position.
hint.d3d12: Set `lightPos.z` in `OnUpdate()` before the six shadow matrices are made, from a time since the start: a `static auto startTime = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();` and the `duration` up to `currentFrame`.

ex-far-plane.text: Lower the shadow cube map's far plane from 25 to 6. Why does everything further than 6 units from the light suddenly lie in shadow?
ex-far-plane.hint: Only `far_plane` changes. The depth pass no longer draws anything beyond 6 units, so there the cube map keeps the value it was cleared to: 1.0 – that is 6 units once multiplied by `far_plane`. Compare that with the fragment's real distance.

ex-add-cube.text: Add a sixth cube to the room, at (1.5, −1, −2.5) with scale 0.5, so that you see both it and the shadow it throws on the back wall.

hint.opengl: `renderScene` draws the scene for both passes – add the cube there (translate, scale, `setMat4("model", …)`, `renderCube()`) and it lands in the cube map and in the picture.
hint.vulkan: `renderScene` records the scene for both passes – add the cube there (its model matrix in the push constants, then `vkCmdDraw`) and it lands in the cube map and in the picture.
hint.d3d12: `RenderScene` records the scene for both passes – add the cube there (scaling × translation, its model and normal matrix in the root constants, then `DrawInstanced`) and it lands in the cube map and in the picture.

ex-move-light.text: Move the light up near the ceiling, to (−1.5, 4, −1), right above the rotated cube in the top left. Its shadow now falls down over the back wall.

hint.opengl: Only `lightPos` changes – the six cube map views are made from it every frame. The light and the camera are no longer on one line, so the cube no longer hides its own shadow.
hint.vulkan: Only the global `lightPos` changes – the six cube map views are made from it every frame. The light and the camera are no longer on one line, so the cube no longer hides its own shadow.
